On reddit it's a fairly popular subreddit. The goal is exactly that. Have people try to debate you and give good arguments to change your view on whatever subject.

Have you seen changemyview on reddit? Basically, somebody makes a statement that they believe in, but are open to having their mind changed if somebody is persuasive enough with their replies. For example, you might post, "I believe that gays should not be allowed to marry." Then other people will give you reasons why you should change your view on gay marriage. If they succeed, you award them a delta.
